PATIENT INFORMATION

Your right to a Good Faith Estimate

Prepared October 4, 2026 · Effective date: pending practice adoption

If you are uninsured or will pay for your care without using insurance, you can request a written estimate of expected charges before treatment.

Before your appointment

You have the right to an estimate of the total expected charges for health care items and services, including related costs.

  • When you book 3–9 business days ahead, the written estimate is due within 1 business day after scheduling.
  • When you book at least 10 business days ahead, it is due within 3 business days after scheduling.
  • You can also request an estimate before booking; it is due within 3 business days of your request.

If your bill is higher

You may dispute a provider’s or facility’s bill if it is at least $400 higher than that provider’s or facility’s estimate. Keep a copy of your estimate.

Request an estimate

Contact our office before your visit.
